name: Serious / fatal workplace injury
description: Machinery, chemical or process incident causes injury or death. HSE prosecution + corporate manslaughter risk.

name: Environmental incident (spill, emissions, waste)
description: Spill, fugitive emissions or unlicensed waste route causes regulator action.

name: Critical-component supply disruption
description: Single-source or sanctioned-jurisdiction component disrupted; production halted.

name: Dual-use / restricted export breach
description: Component or finished good exported in breach of dual-use / sanctions regime.

name: Forced / trafficked labour in supply chain
description: Tier-2 / tier-3 supplier uses forced or trafficked labour.

name: Bribery in public-sector / infrastructure project
description: Agent or employee makes facilitation payment to win or expedite a project.
